text:
Jamie: heading into the midnight edge-normalize cutover now. small client shim in place but want to hold if older clients show failures. @Sasha can you confirm the mobile downstream probe?
Sasha: running the probe now, expect results in ~2m. sending logs.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job started: rollout_id=roll_6472 stage=canary nodes=10->50% next_check=6460001125
Marco: saw an uptick in 4xx on canary-2, looks like header-case mismatch from older SDKs. sample: `GET /v2/generate` header `x-client-v: 1.6.3` vs `X-Client-V: 1.6.3`
Lina: can confirm, mobile SDK <1.8 normalizes differently; new edge-normalize was strict. adding a temporary accept-both shim at the edge and pushing hotfix to canary nodes (+1m).
Jamie: decision: pause the next traffic bump until 2 consecutive probe runs show 4xx <= 0.5% for the canary. also update release notes to call out header behavior and recommended client upgrade window. @Olive please update the ops doc and release-notes.
Olive: updating release notes and the operator checklist now. adding rollback criteria: error-rate >=1% OR latency_p95 > 800ms sustained for 5m triggers immediate rollback to previous header behavior.
Sasha: probes back at 6460001128 — canary-2 4xx = 0.12% after shim, traces show header-normalize tolerating both case variants.
deploy-bot: rollout paused by operator Jamie at 6460001130. current_traffic=50% canary_health=healthy manual_approval_required=true
Marco: I'll schedule a targeted backfill for older SDK traffic in the next maintenance window and open a ticket to client teams to expedite upgrades.
Jamie: ok we'll keep the rollout paused for 2 hours to watch real traffic. ops oncall please monitor tenant error spikes and attach tenant id + traces if anything appears.
Lina: pinging customer-success to proactively notify top-10 tenants about the header change and recommended SDK versions.
deploy-bot: operator handoff scheduled to oncall at 6460001140. job_state=paused notes="awaiting probe stability and release-note sync" :hourglass:
Jamie: thanks all — reconvene if alerts flip. :thumbsup:
